picks.editorial_note: UW leads and supports four DOE Genesis Mission awards within a 300+ institution national AI-for-science push — the broadest, best-funded initiative in this week's slate and a bellwether for how federal AI research investment is being organized.
picks.title: UW researchers lead and support new ‘AI-for-Science’ Genesis Mission awards | UW News

picks.editorial_note: A $14.2M DOE-funded foundation model for the U.S. electric grid, led by Brookhaven with Stony Brook, shows AI-for-science funding translating into concrete infrastructure applications with national-security relevance.
picks.title: BNL to Lead $14M AI Project for Nation's Electric Grid Through Genesis Mission

picks.editorial_note: A $10M OpenAI Foundation grant (part of $60M) to bring AI weather and crop-disease forecasting to millions of farmers is a rare case of academic AI research reaching real-world scale with direct humanitarian impact.
picks.title: AIM for Scale receives $10 million to bring AI-powered weather services to millions of farmers

picks.editorial_note: A $20 million naming gift establishing an entire College of Artificial Intelligence at UNT signals how major donors are now betting on AI as core university infrastructure, not just a research niche.
picks.title: UNT receives $20 million gift to advance artificial intelligence, advanced analytics

picks.editorial_note: UNSW's rollout of ChatGPT Edu to 80,000+ students and staff is one of the largest AI-in-education deployments in the Asia-Pacific region, a bellwether for how universities are institutionalizing AI access at scale.
picks.title: UNSW partners with OpenAI to support the first generation of AI natives in the workforce

picks.editorial_note: University of Kentucky's selection for DOE's 'Mine of the Future' initiative marks a notable expansion of federal AI investment into critical-minerals infrastructure, linking academic research directly to national resource strategy.
picks.title: UK selected to help advance DOE ‘Mine of the Future’ initiative

picks.editorial_note: USF's unveiling of a dedicated building for its $40M-backed Bellini College of AI, Cybersecurity and Computing reflects the scale at which universities are now making permanent physical bets on AI education.
picks.title: USF President Limayem announces location, unveils plans for new Bellini College building

picks.editorial_note: MIT CSAIL's InstructMesh, developed with Google and Northeastern, lets users repair and fabricate AI-generated 3D models reliably — a meaningful step toward making generative design tools usable for real manufacturing.
picks.title: New tool lets users repair AI-generated 3D models, then fabricate them just the way they want

picks.editorial_note: Sandia's ETCRAM analog memory technology, achieving 100x density gains over binary storage, is a genuine materials-science advance that could reshape the hardware powering future AI systems.
picks.title: New analog memory may make smart devices even smarter

picks.editorial_note: OpenAI's claimed solution to a Millennium Prize math problem, met with public skepticism from UCLA's Terence Tao, is a high-profile test case for how the field verifies extraordinary AI claims.
picks.title: OpenAI says it has solved one of math’s 'Millennium Problems' — and more UCLA media
